home.metaTitle: Free online tools for images, text and calculations
home.metaDescription: Free, private, browser-based tools: compress and convert images, count words, clean text, and calculate percentages and discounts. No sign-up required.
home.heroTitle: Free tools that work right in your browser
home.heroSubtitle: Compress images, convert formats, count words and calculate percentages in seconds. No account, no uploads for most tools, no clutter.
home.noArticles: Guides are being written and reviewed. Check back soon.
home.how1Body: Search or browse by category. Every tool opens instantly without registration.
home.how2Body: Image and text tools run inside your browser, so your files are not sent to our servers.
home.how3Body: Review the result, then copy it or save it to your device. Reset any time to start again.
home.trust1Body: Each tool page states exactly where your data is processed. Our current tools run entirely in your browser.
home.trust2Body: You never need an account to use a tool.
home.trust3Body: Every tool and page is available in English, French and Arabic.
home.trust4Body: Read our privacy, editorial and corrections policies to see how we work.
home.servicesBody: The Nexoraat team behind this site builds websites, apps and digital strategies.

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.body: We use necessary storage to run the site. With your permission, we would also use analytics to understand which tools help people, and advertising storage to fund the site. You can change your choice at any time in Cookie Settings.
consent.necessaryDesc: Required for core features such as remembering your language, theme and privacy choices. Always on.
consent.analyticsDesc: Helps us measure tool usage in aggregate. Never includes your text, files or results.
consent.adsDesc: Allows advertising partners such as Google to use storage for ad delivery, measurement and personalization.
consent.noChoice: You have not made a choice yet. Optional storage is off.
consent.externalCmp: Consent for advertising is managed by a certified consent platform. Use the privacy link it provides to change your choices.

services.title: Digital services for ambitious businesses
services.intro: This site is built and maintained by Nexoraat, a digital agency in Marrakech, Morocco. Beyond free tools, the team builds websites, apps and digital strategies for businesses in Morocco, Europe and beyond.

web.title: Web development
web.body: Full-stack web development on Next.js, React, Laravel and WordPress, from marketing sites to e-commerce and SaaS platforms, built to load fast and convert.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.body: Native and cross-platform mobile applications that bring your business directly to your customers’ pockets.

design.title: UI/UX design
design.body: Intuitive, well-crafted user interfaces that deliver a consistent experience across every device.

seo.title: SEO
seo.body: Technical and content SEO that builds sustainable organic visibility, not quick tricks that fade after the next algorithm update.

geo.title: GEO: AI search visibility
geo.body: Structure your content and site so AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can find, understand and cite you.

marketing.title: Digital marketing
marketing.body: Paid ads, social media and email campaigns planned and tracked against real business outcomes, not just impressions.

ai.title: AI & automation
ai.body: AI-powered features and backend automation, from content and chat assistants to workflow integrations.

analytics.title: Digital analytics
analytics.body: Data analysis to understand visitor behaviour and improve your digital presence.

services.ctaBody: Tell us what you need. We reply by email, usually within a few working days.

agency.title: Built by Nexoraat
agency.body: Nexoraat is a digital agency based in Marrakech, Morocco. It designs and develops this site and its tools, and builds websites, mobile apps and digital strategies for businesses.

bgremove.firstRunNotice: The first time, your browser downloads the AI model (up to about {size} MB) from Hugging Face and keeps it in its cache for next time. Your image is never uploaded: it is processed on your device.
bgremove.error: The background could not be removed. Try again; if it keeps failing, try Chrome or Edge on a computer and share the technical details with us.
bgremove.scaledNote: Large photos are processed at {width} × {height} pixels to protect your device’s memory.
bgremove.portraitMode: Your browser doesn’t support WebGPU, so a lighter AI model that works best on people is used. For products and objects, open this page in a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Safari on a computer.
bgremove.errorNetwork: The AI model could not be downloaded. An ad blocker, privacy extension, Brave Shields, antivirus web protection or a firewall may be blocking huggingface.co or cdn.jsdelivr.net. Allow those sites (or pause the blocker for this page), then try again.
bgremove.errorReload: This page was open while the site was updated, so the tool couldn’t start. Reload the page and try again.
